bibman_core_library_notes: v10: new papers' PDFs are saved to Drive again (through the bookmarklet's web app); one-time PDF checks in the bookmarklet project. In each web app: Libraries → BibManCore → select version 10, then Deploy → Manage deployments → Edit → New version
bibman_frontend_thinclient_webapp_notes: v14: select Core 10 and redeploy (Code.gs unchanged)
bibman_bookmarklet_capture_webapp_notes: v10: new Code.gs (PDF saving, one-time PDF checks, authorizeDrive); add the Script Property PDF_FOLDER_ID (same value as in the dashboard project) and the Drive API service (Services → + → Drive API), select Core 10, redeploy, then run authorizeDrive once in the editor and allow the permissions
